high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) at the National Library of Medicine (NLM), NIH.gov. The URL displayed in the address bar is "pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov," indicating that the page is likely part of PubMed Central, which hosts peer-reviewed research articles. The content of the webpage discusses a critical problem faced by sensory systems: self-generated signals, such as motion, can dramatically alter sensory input, overwhelming more important externally generated signals.
